__root__.rationale: Protocol invocation wrappers are transport internals, not user features.

account.rationale: Account preferences, privacy, sessions, and device registration need a product-level audit.

aicompose.rationale: Telegram experimental server-side AI composition is not a portable client feature.

auth.rationale: Authentication and session restoration are implemented by the account coordinator.

bots.rationale: Bot management and business flows require separate client scenarios.

channels.rationale: Reading channels works through dialogs; administration needs a separate audit.

chatlists.rationale: Telegram-native folders are covered; shared chat lists remain unimplemented.

communities.rationale: Community-specific server features need a product decision.

contacts.rationale: Contact management is not yet a dedicated workspace workflow.

ephemeral.rationale: Experimental ephemeral protocol endpoints are not a stable client commitment.

folders.rationale: Dialog folders and archive are exposed in the workspace.

fragment.rationale: Fragment marketplace operations are outside this desktop client scope.

help.rationale: Update and support metadata need a release-management decision.

langpack.rationale: Telegram server language packs are not yet integrated with application localization.

messages.rationale: Core dialogs, history, search, sending, editing, forwarding, media, drafts, and pins are implemented.

payments.rationale: Payment flows require security and compliance product design.

phone.rationale: Calls and phone verification need dedicated desktop workflows.

photos.rationale: Avatar retrieval is covered through client helpers; full photo management is not.

premium.rationale: Premium-specific purchase and promotion flows are not implemented.

smsjobs.rationale: SMS job infrastructure is not a normal Telegram client feature.

stats.rationale: Channel and group analytics need a product-level audit.

stickers.rationale: Sticker catalog, packs, favorites, recents, search, and sending are implemented.

stories.rationale: Story viewing and publishing are not yet implemented.

updates.rationale: The live workspace subscribes to and synchronizes Telegram updates.

upload.rationale: Composer attachments and cache-backed downloads are implemented.

users.rationale: User lookup supports existing chat flows; a complete people-management surface is pending.
